$comment: Single source of truth for the container images shared across this workspace.
These five services are each declared by more than one repository, and every
one of them had drifted: loki 2.9.3 vs 3.4.2, grafana 10.2.3 vs 11.6.1,
prometheus v2.51.2 vs v2.53.4, qdrant v1.9.7 vs v1.14.1, open-webui :main vs
v0.9.6. Nothing compared them, so nothing reported it — the loki split only
surfaced when a config written for 2.x met the 3.x binary and crash-looped
qdrant is the one that is not merely untidy: the engines and localAIStack
share a single running instance (RealityEngine_CPP/stop.sh says so), so two
repos declaring different versions of the same vector store is a data-format
this file. Change a version here and in the compose files together; the

grafana/loki.migration_note: 3.x removed compactor.shared_store; config/loki-config.yml must use delete_request_store.

grafana/promtail.migration_note: Kept in lockstep with loki; promtail and loki are released together.

qdrant/qdrant.migration_note: One instance is shared at runtime. RealityEngine_CI/Dockerfile.qdrant exists only to add a healthcheck binary that v1.9.7 lacked; re-check whether that is still required.

ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui.migration_note: localOpenClawStack resolves a @sha256 digest into .env via scripts/update-versions.sh; the tag here is what that digest must correspond to. localAIStack tracked :main, which is not a version at all.
